BILGE.gloss: water accumulated in the bilge of a ship
BILGE.definition: Water accumulated in the bilge of a ship.

BILE.gloss: a digestive juice secreted by the liver and stored in the gallbladder
BILE.definition: A digestive juice secreted by the liver and stored in the gallbladder; aids in the digestion of fats.

BIG.gloss: above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent
BIG.definition: Above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent.

LIE.definition: Be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.
